ei.title: Translation from Various Texts, Conversations and Expectations
ei.subject: 10월_2024 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Translation from Various Texts, Conversations and Expectations

fullPassage: All translators feel some pressure from the community of readers for whom they are doing their work. And all translators arrive at their interpretations in dialogue with other people. The English poet Alexander Pope had pretty good Greek, but when he set about translating Homer's Iliad in the early 18th century he was not on his own. He had Greek commentaries to refer to, and translations that had already been done in English, Latin, and French ― and of course he had dictionaries. Translators always draw on more than one source text. Even when the scene of translation consists of just one person with a pen, paper, and the book that is being translated, or even when it is just one person translating orally for another, that person's linguistic knowledge arises from lots of other texts and other conversations. And then his or her idea of the translation's purpose will be influenced by the expectations of the person or people it is for. In both these senses every translation is a crowd translation.

det.korean: being translating → being translated: 현재진행 수동태는 be being + p.p. 형태여야 한다. 복합 시제(진행+수동) 혼동 유도

det.korean: dispose of(처분하다)는 draw on(활용하다)의 반의어. 번역가가 여러 원문을 '활용'한다는 맥락과 모순
det.analysis:
❌ ① pressure(압박) — 원문 일치. 독자 공동체로부터 받는 압박

❌ ④ crowd(군중) — 원문 일치. 모든 번역은 군중 번역이라는 결론
det.tip: draw on(활용하다) ≠ dispose of(처분하다)

det.korean: unaffected(영향받지 않는)는 influenced(영향을 받는)의 반의어. 번역 목적이 기대에 의해 '영향받지 않는다'는 글의 논지와 정반대
det.analysis:
❌ ① dialogue(대화) — 원문 일치. 다른 사람들과의 대화 속에서 해석 도달

❌ ② linguistic(언어적) — 원문 일치. 언어적 지식

✅ ③ unaffected(영향받지 않는) — 원문 influenced(영향을 받는). 번역 목적이 기대에 의해 영향받는다는 맥락에 모순 ←정답

❌ ④ crowd(군중) — 원문 일치. 모든 번역은 군중 번역이라는 결론

det.korean: 번역가는 항상 하나 이상의 원문(more than one source text)을 활용한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① more than one source text(하나 이상의 원문) — Pope의 예시에서 그리스어 주석, 기존 번역, 사전 등 다수 참고 ←정답

det.korean: 모든 번역은 군중 번역(a crowd translation)이다 — 글의 결론

❌ ② a mechanical process(기계적 과정) — 본문에 기계적 과정 언급 없음

❌ ③ a literary masterpiece(문학적 걸작) — 번역의 질이 아닌 성격을 논함

✅ ④ a crowd translation(군중 번역) — 다양한 텍스트와 대화, 기대가 반영되므로 ←정답

He had Greek commentaries to refer to, and translations that had already been done in English, Latin, and French ― and of course he had dictionaries. Translators always draw on more than one source text. Even when the scene of translation consists of just one person with a pen, paper, and the book that is being translated, or even when it is just one person translating orally for another, that person's linguistic knowledge arises from lots of other texts and other conversations. And then his or her idea of the translation's purpose will be influenced by the expectations of the person or people it is for. In both these senses every translation is a crowd translation.
